title: Cu Chi Tunnels
source_topic: ICPC / The 2017 ACM - Asia Ho Chi Minh City Regional Contest
statement: A network of N rooms is connected by N-1 tunnels forming a tree whose rooms are numbered so that indices strictly increase along every shortest path from room 1. Given the array of degrees, one per room, the task is to decide whether such a network can exist and print YES or NO, with N at most one thousand.
